correctness.rationale: A cyclic arc has a computable sum, and {1,q} plus disjoint selected prefixes and suffixes of the two interior paths is connected. The 1017-file witness pairs are complete and all q in 3..n-2. Independently reconstructed chords.txt byte-equivalent witness data, verified its exact Git blob SHA and recomputed target inclusion with a separate Python big-integer bitset implementation for ALL n=8..1024; every one of the targets 1..n(n+1)/2 was covered. The lower bound mEC(n)>=1 for n>=8 is the established Marotti-Needleman theorem. This finite-range statement is certified for exactly 1017 values, never extrapolated to n>1024.
